📋 12 Entry Points

Eligibility

Eligibility — Age, Residency, Qualifying Period

Age 16-SPA. UK resident. Habitual residence test. 3-month qualifying + 9-month prospective. Immigration control / NRPF exclusion. PIP replaces DLA for working-age claims. AA separate for SPA+. SRTI bypass qualifying period. NI number required.

Daily Living

Daily Living Component — 10 Descriptors, Points Threshold

10 descriptors: nutrition, washing, toilet, dressing, communicating, reading, engaging, budgeting, medication, bathing. Each 0-12 points. Standard 8+ pts, Enhanced 12+ pts. Needs-based: majority of days. Aided vs unaided. Safely, repeatedly, acceptable standard, reasonable time.

Mobility

Mobility Component — 2 Descriptors, Planning and Moving

2 descriptors: planning/following journeys, moving around. D1: cognitive, visual, psychological barriers. D2: physical — 50m benchmark, aids, wheelchair. Standard 8+ pts, Enhanced 12+ pts. Enhanced Mobility triggers Motability. Overlapping mobility awards excluded.

Assessment

Assessment Process — CHDA, Health Professional, Observation

CHDA health professional. F2F, telephone, or video. Functional assessment against PIP descriptors. Evidence from GP, consultant, CPN, OT. PA3/PA4 report. HP recommendation vs DM decision. Paper-based where evidence sufficient. Home visits for mobility-restricted.

PIP2

PIP2 Claim Form — 'How Your Disability Affects You'

PIP2: 'How your disability affects you'. 28-day return. Evidence: GP/consultant letters, CPN statements, medication list, diary. Good days/bad days variability. Aids and appliances. Section 12 info. Phone alternative. Claim date = PIP call date.

MR/Appeal

Mandatory Reconsideration — 28-Day Request, Appeal Rights

MR request within 28 days. DWP DM reviews. New evidence at MR. Partial decisions — component/level changes. Appeal to HMCTS First-tier Tribunal within 1 month. Late appeals up to 13 months. Oral or paper hearing. Tribunal can increase, decrease, or maintain. Upper Tribunal on point of law.

Terminal

Terminal Illness — SR1/SR2, Special Rules, Fast-Track

SRTI. SR1/SR2 from GP/consultant. Death within 12 months. Enhanced DL + Enhanced Mobility auto-awarded. Fast-track under 48hrs. 3-year award. No qualifying period. No F2F assessment. Backdating to claim date.

Rates

Rates and Points — Weekly Payments, Thresholds, Uprating

DL standard £72.65/wk, enhanced £108.55/wk. Mobility standard £28.70/wk, enhanced £75.75/wk. 8pts standard, 12pts enhanced. Both components payable. PIP DL overlaps with AA/CAA. PIP Mobility overlaps with DLA Mobility. Tax-free. Not means-tested. Annual CPI uprating.

Reviews

Reviews and Renewals — Light-Touch, CoC, DLA Transfer

AR1 review. Light-touch at 10 years for stable conditions. CoC — worsening, new condition, hospital, prison. DLA to PIP migration. Award: ongoing or fixed-term (1-10 years). Review can increase, decrease, or maintain. ADP (Scotland) replacement.

Passporting

Passporting and Interactions — UC, Motability, Blue Badge

PIP Enhanced DL → UC LCWRA. Carer premium for CA claimant. Motability: Enhanced Mobility lease. Blue Badge (Enhanced Mobility or 8+ pts DL 11/12). Bus pass. Winter Fuel top-up. Warm Home Discount. Council Tax reduction. HB disability premium. SDP/UC interaction.

Data

Data Governance — 3.4M Claimants, Award Rates, Overturn Rates

3.4M PIP claimants. Award rates by condition — mental health, musculoskeletal, neurological. MR overturn ~70%+. Tribunal overturn ~75%+. Assessment provider performance. GDPR compliance. FOI readiness. Stat-Xplore data. Quarterly official statistics.

Parliamentary

Parliamentary Evidence — Reform, Scrutiny, UNCRPD

PIP green paper reform. W&P Select Committee scrutiny. Disability PQ evidence — award rates, overturn stats, waiting times. UNCRPD compliance. Disability Action Plan. WCA interaction. Health and Disability White Paper. Condition-specific PQs.

⚡ 8 Transformation Priorities

1. Assessment Modernisation

Digital PIP2 — online submission with evidence upload. Video assessment expansion. AI-assisted evidence triage — auto-categorise documents, flag gaps. Digital self-serve descriptor pre-population. Assessment scheduling optimisation. Reduced wait times. Telephony integration. Easy Read digital PIP2. Welsh language form. Target: 80% digital PIP2 submissions by 2028, claim-to-decision from 16 weeks to 8 weeks.

2. Decision Accuracy

Reduce MR overturn rate from 70%+ to under 30%. AI evidence cross-check — compare PIP2 vs GP/consultant evidence. Descriptor scoring calibration for HPs. QA sampling of assessment reports. DM dashboard with evidence completeness score. Common overturn pattern detection. HP training feedback from tribunal outcomes. Target: MR overturn under 30%, tribunal overturn under 40% by 2028.

3. Fast-Track Automation

SR1 auto-award — enhanced DL + Mobility on SR1 receipt, no manual DM. Terminal illness under 48hrs. Fast-track notification to claimant/carer. Bereavement support payment auto-trigger. NHS palliative care integration. Hospice notification. DWP SLA monitoring. No assessment for SRTI. Backdate automation. Target: 100% SRTI claims within 48 hours, zero manual delays.

4. Review Light-Touching

10-year light-touch reviews for stable conditions. Condition-based award duration. Paper-based review for unchanged conditions. Automated CoC detection from UC/NHS data. Award extension for over-65s approaching SPA. Reduced reassessment anxiety. Claimant review portal. Digital award notification. Target: 60% of awards light-touch or ongoing by 2028, halving reassessment volumes.

5. Integration with Health Records

NHS Spine for GP evidence auto-pull. Summary Care Record access. Hospital episode data. Mental health service data. Community OT/physio records. EPS medication data. Condition registry. Consent-based sharing. NHS App notification. Target: 50% of assessment evidence auto-sourced from NHS by 2028, reducing GP letter burden.

6. Motability Digital

Digital Motability application — online vehicle selection/lease. Vehicle matching by disability needs. Adaptation grant checker. Digital lease management. WAV search. EV transition support. Scheme eligibility auto-verification from PIP award. Target: 100% digital Motability journey by 2028, lease processing from 6 weeks to 2 weeks.

7. Appeals Reduction

Better first decisions — evidence quality scoring at claim stage. Pre-decision evidence gap alert. NPS audit trail. DM decision support with descriptor guidance. Tribunal trend feedback to providers. Early reconsideration offer. Claimant outcome prediction. Target: 50% reduction in MR/appeal volumes by 2028 through improved first-instance decision quality.

8. Parliamentary Evidence

Real-time PIP dashboard — award rates, condition breakdown, regional distribution. W&P Select Committee automated reporting. PQ evidence generator — award stats, overturn rates, waiting times. Provider performance comparison. UNCRPD compliance metrics. Cross-benefit data. Claimant demographic analysis. Target: Quarterly automated parliamentary briefing packs on PIP performance for all MPs and Peers.

🚫 Red Lines (Never Crossed)

  • ❌ No PIP decision without qualified DWP decision maker (DM) review — every award, refusal, or change must be made by a trained DM, not by automated system or assessment provider alone
  • ❌ No assessment without claimant consent and evidence right — claimant must be informed of assessment purpose, able to submit evidence, and request reasonable adjustments
  • ❌ No PIP data shared without explicit claimant consent under UK GDPR — health records, assessment reports, and personal data require specific consent for each data flow
  • ❌ No terminal illness claim delayed beyond 48hrs under special rules — SR1-triggered claims must be fast-tracked to decision within 2 working days, zero exceptions
  • ❌ No automated decision that overrides health professional (HP) assessment without human DM sign-off — AI may assist but cannot overrule HP clinical recommendation unilaterally
  • ❌ No PIP information used for fraud investigation without separate legal basis — PIP claim data governed by social security law, not fraud investigation powers, unless specific DWP fraud referral exists
